easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Use Blim to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 2.
